title: Trump Rules Out Striking Iran Before Nov 3 Midterms; Iran Reviewing US Hormuz Proposal
detail: Trump said on Truth Social the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, calling talks with Tehran productive and saying he expects the war to end soon. Iran said it was still reviewing a US proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

media.caption: Iran weighs US response as Trump rules out attack before midterms
